title: Low volume
text: Low volume. I’m a little disappointed by the volume of soap that comes out. I need to go back three times just to get enough soap. Maybe my soap is too thick.

product_metadata.title: Solvac Wall Mounted Soap Dispenser Touchless - Large Refillable Battery- back Battery Compartment - kitchen soap dispenser Adjustable Liquid Volume - 17oz/500 ml
features: MESS-FREE USE - Using traditional bars and pumps leave a slimy residue on your bathroom or kitchen sink. Our improved touchless soap dispenser dispenses straight to your hands without leaking or dripping.
EASY TO OPERATE - There's no need to manually pump a dispensing bottle for washing your hands. Just place your hand underneath the nozzle to automatically get a good-sized drop of liquid soap.
COMPACT, MODERN DESIGN - Our 8.7" x 6.1" sensor dispenser is perfect for wall mount or countertop placement for extra convenience. Its transparent reservoir allows you to see how much soap is left.

LONGER BATTERY LIFE - Our dispenser's battery compartment is placed at the back to protect against moisture. The energy efficiency feature allows it to dispense for a year without replacing batteries.

MULTIPLE ADJUSTABLE - Our Automatic soap dispenser control the Liquid Volume by Power switch (On/Off) you will be able to adjust for different amounts dispensed you want to come out. This is great for your kids because you will keep the soap from being waste
